770-2226-2499.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
770-2226-2499.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Yarok.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Man-o'-War by paying its mana cost.
When Man-o'-War enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

789-3845-4279--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
789-3845-4279--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit, Gutter Grime and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Gutter Grime ability, creating a X/X Ooze creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit triggers, causing you to gain 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

1981-2034-2415-6458.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
Thunder of Unity's second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
1981-2034-2415-6458.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Thunder of Unity triggers, causing you to gain life and each opponent to lose life.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

969-1843-3259.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
969-1843-3259.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Tervigon, triggering Breath of Fury and Tervigon.
Resolve the Tervigon trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

341-489-4200-6867.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Icewind Stalwart with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Icewind Stalwart from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Icewind Stalwart enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

475-3263-5641-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
475-3263-5641-6996.description:
Gain life in any way.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice.
Leonin Elder triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

1619-4605-5147-5542-6138.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4605-5147-5542-6138.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Bloodboil Sorcerer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Bloodboil Sorcerer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Bloodboil Sorcerer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Bloodboil Sorcerer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Bloodboil Sorcerer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Bloodboil Sorcerer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Bloodboil Sorcerer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Bloodboil Sorcerer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-4605-5147-5542-6138.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

1115-3259-7357.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1115-3259-7357.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Pugnacious Pugilist as attackers.
Pugnacious Pugilist triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
If the sacrificed creature was a Devil token, it triggers when it dies, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat each combat phase.

2374-6797-7084.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Maja triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

2981-6837-6871-6879.description:
Cast Three Tree Mascot by paying {2}.
When Three Tree Mascot enters, Haru triggers, targeting Three Tree Mascot as it is a land due to Toph.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Three Tree Mascot.
When Three Tree Mascot dies, Haru triggers, returning Three Tree Mascot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Three Tree Mascot enters, Haru triggers, targeting Three Tree Mascot as it is a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Megatog ability.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

1409-4772-7009.manaNeeded: {1}{U} plus an additional {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
1409-4772-7009.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {1}{U}, blinking it and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk with two lore counters on it due to Doubling Season.
The Legend of Kuruk's first and second chapter abilities trigger, causing you to scry 2, draw a card, scry 2 and draw another card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting two lore counters on it. Its third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
When Avatar Kuruk enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Grim Poppet and with toughness 2 or greater

1084-3108-3388.description:
Activate Grim Poppet by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Moritte of the Frost.
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Moritte of the Frost by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Grim Poppet.
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

56-2523-5256-6887.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional untapped black and/or green creature.
56-2523-5256-6887.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Hogaak.
When Hogaak dies, The Skullspore Nexus and Ratadrabik of Urborg trigger, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill eight cards.
Cast Hogaak from your graveyard by exiling five cards from your graveyard and tapping two black and/or green creatures you control.
Repeat.
56-2523-5256-6887.notes: Once you've milled your library, you may repeat the loop as the number of cards in your graveyard allows and decide to mill another player.

3490-4050-6283-6752.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
You have a nonland card on top of your library.
3490-4050-6283-6752.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Haliya indestructible.
3490-4050-6283-6752.description:
Gain life.
Amalia triggers, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Haliya triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Amalia triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}
Resolve the Amalia trigger, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Repeat from step 3.

1563-2457-4785-6753.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

586-997-3168-5258-5618.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {1}
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

2558-3490-4779-5231-6701.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
When you sacrifice Sword of the Meek, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on another creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Servo.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Repeat.
2558-3490-4779-5231-6701.notes: The combo puts infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel. If desired, you can sacrifice the Servos as well.

5295-6575-6684.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
When Esper Terra enters the battlefield, its first chapter ability triggers, creating a token copy of The First Tyrannic War and then putting two lore counters on it.
The First Tyrannic War token's first, second and third chapter abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger. Then, resolve the second trigger, putting a lore counter on Esper Terra.
Esper Terra's second chapter ability triggers, creating a token copy of a nonlegendary enchantment you control.
Resolve the third First Tyrannic War trigger, putting two lore counters on Esper Terra and causing you to sacrifice the First Tyrannic War token.
Esper Terra's third and fourth chapter abilities trigger. Resolve the third ability's trigger, creating a token copy of a nonlegendary enchantment you control.
Resolve the fourth trigger, causing you to add {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}, and then exile Esper Terra and return it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
When Terra, Magical Adept enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill five cards and return up to one enchantment card from among them from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

413-4775-6553.easyPrerequisites: Necrogen Communion attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
413-4775-6553.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Necrogen Communion triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Brotherhood Outcast trigger, returning Necrogen Communion from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

413-2281-5925.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Jackdaw Savior.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Jackdaw Savior.
When Jackdaw Savior dies, it and Saffi trigger.
Resolve the Jackdaw Savior trigger, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Saffi enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Jackdaw Savior from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Jackdaw Savior enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 2.
Repeat.

914-2079-3036.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-2079-3036.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least five Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Wizard Mentor by paying {2}{U}.
Activate Wizard Mentor by tapping it, returning it and Dockside Extortionist to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.
If opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens.

24-4435-5644.description:
Cast Wheel of Misfortune by paying {2}{R}.
Judith triggers, giving Wheel of Misfortune deathtouch and lifelink.
Resolve Wheel of Misfortune, choosing an arbitrarily large number.
If you didn't choose the largest number, Wheel of Misfortune deals damage equal to the highest number chosen to each player that chose it, causing those players to lose the game due to having 0 or less life.
If you chose the largest number, Wheel of Misfortune deals that much damage to you and causes you to gain twice that much life.

2292-2724-3217-3582.description:
Activate Kaya the Inexorable's first ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, putting a ghostform counter on Wormfang Manta.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Wormfang Manta.
When Wormfang Manta dies, its second ability and its ghostform ability trigger.
Resolve the ghostform trigger, returning Wormfang Manta from your graveyard to your hand and creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the second trigger, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Cast Wormfang Manta by paying {5}{U}{U}.
Wormfang Manta's first ability does not trigger due to Tocatli Honor Guard.
Repeat each turn.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1232-1270-1322-5477.description:
Activate Nemata's first ability by paying {2}{G}, creating three 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate the Saprolings by tapping them, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat.

2792-2875-3489.notablePrerequisites:
Azra Smokeshaper does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{B}{B}.
2792-2875-3489.description:
Declare Azra Smokeshaper as an attacker.
When it isn't blocked, activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{B}{B}.
Activate Great Whale's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{U}{B} and returning Azra Smokeshaper from the battlefield to your hand, putting Great Whale onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
When Great Whale enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Azra Smokeshaper's ninjutsu ability by paying {1}{B} and returning Great Whale from the battlefield to your hand, putting Azra Smokeshaper onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
Repeat from step 2.
If you control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{B}{B}, this combo nets infinite mana.

1294-2167-2638-4423-4426.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Islands and one basic Forest.
1294-2167-2638-4423-4426.description:
Activate a basic Forest you control by tapping it, adding {G}.
Cast Summer Bloom by paying {1}{G}, allowing you to play three more lands this turn.
Play Mystic Sanctuary either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it and Tireless Tracker's first ability trigger.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Summer Bloom on top of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing Mystic Sanctuary, a basic Forest and any other land you control, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Play the Forest and another land from your graveyard.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Tireless Tracker's first ability triggers twice, creating two Clue artifact tokens.
Activate a Clue by paying {2} and sacrificing it.
Tireless Tracker's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Clue ability, causing you to draw Summer Bloom from the top of your library.
Repeat.

2068-2173-4993.notablePrerequisites:
Each opponent's life total is no greater than 40.
You control at least 18 other nonland permanents.
2068-2173-4993.description:
Activate Bolas's Citadel by tapping it and sacrificing ten other nonland permanents you control.
Ashnod the Uncaring triggers, copying Bolas's Citadel's ability.
Resolve both Bolas's Citadel abilities, causing each opponent to lose 20 life.
Each opponent that had 20 or less life loses the game due to having 0 or less life.
Activate Manifold Key's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Bolas's Citadel.
Activate Bolas's Citadel by tapping it and sacrificing itself, Manifold Key, and eight other nonland permanents you control.
Ashnod the Uncaring triggers, copying Bolas's Citadel's ability.
Resolve both Bolas's Citadel abilities, causing each opponent to lose 20 life.
Each remaining opponent loses the game due to having 0 or less life.

948-2060-2433-2486-4772.notablePrerequisites:
Your commander on the battlefield.
You have at least one +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
948-2060-2433-2486-4772.description:
Activate Ooze Flux by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating two 1/1 Ooze creature tokens, which will enter the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters each due to Doubling Season and Master Chef.
Rosie Cotton of South Lane triggers twice, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler and any creature you control due to Doubling Season.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

3321-4659-4985-5220.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Filigree Familiar, adding {C}{C}.
When Filigree Familiar dies, its second ability and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Filigree Familiar on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Filigree Familiar trigger, causing you to draw Filigree Familiar.
Cast Filigree Familiar by paying {2}.
When Filigree Familiar enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing you to gain two life.
Repeat.

2060-2431-4499.notablePrerequisites: Crystalline Crawler has at least four +1/+1 counters on it.
2060-2431-4499.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Deepglow Skate.
Deepglow Skate enters the battlefield, doubling the number of counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Jadzi, Oracle of Arcavios // Journey to the Oracle

1401-3308-4050-4300.notablePrerequisites: You control at least eight lands, five of which enter the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {5}.
1401-3308-4050-4300.description:
Activate five lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}.
Activate Meloku five times by paying {5} and returning the five lands from the battlefield to your hand, creating five 1/1 Illusion creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar four times by sacrificing four Illusions, adding {2}{G}{G}.
Cast Journey to the Oracle by paying {2}{G}{G}.
Song of Creation's first ability triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve Journey to the Oracle, putting at least five lands from your hand onto the battlefield, then causing you to discard a card and Journey to the Oracle to your hand.
Repeat.

480-3117-3519.notablePrerequisites:
Skullbriar has a croak counter on it.
{B} or
480-3117-3519.description:
Activate Food Chain by exiling Skullbriar, adding {B}{B}{B} or {G}{G}{G} that can only be spent to cast creature spells.
Cast Skullbriar from exile by paying {B}{G}.
Repeat.

1018-4050-4258-4598.description:
Cast Essence Flux by paying {U}.
Sedgemoor Witch triggers, creating a 1/1 Pest creature token.
Resolve Essence Flux, blinking Skullwinder.
Skullwinder enters the battlefield, returning Essence Flux from your graveyard to your hand and causing target opponent to return a card from their graveyard to their hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Pest, adding {U}.
The Pest dies, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.
